**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Exclude padded rows from the new prefill region**

When FULL CUDA graphs pad a real batch to the captured request count, the zero-query padding rows follow the real requests. If any real one-token first chunk sets `no_prior_state=True`, `split_decodes_and_prefills()` finds that first row and counts the entire remaining suffix as prefills, including the trailing rows whose query length is zero. Those rows then enter `has_initial_state`, causal-convolution metadata, and `prefill_state_indices` as real sequences, exposing the chunk kernels to duplicate cu-seqlens and null state slots. The non-speculative path needs to exclude zero-length padding from the prefill count/metadata, as the speculative branch already does.
